name: receipts
description: UNVERIFIED when Claude claims done without a check: a receipt line under every answer that claims done, naming the test or build that ran after the last edit, or saying nothing did. Plus a progress band with an estimate that names its basis.

spike.title: Spike unfamiliar tasks
spike.description: When a task shape has fewer than 3 past samples and the plan has 3 or more steps, spawn one cheap subagent per task to guess minutes per step. Counts as half a sample.

cleanView.title: Tool rows quiet on start
cleanView.description: Start each session at the quiet rows level: tool rows hidden, milestones one dim line, the turn's chrome folded. Off starts with every row drawn in full. The band's settings change it for the session.

crossCheck.title: Cross-check claims of done
crossCheck.description: When a turn with edits claims done, spawn one read-only agent to try to refute it, re-running the verify command if there is one. Its verdict shows on the card. Never blocks the turn.

crossCheckModel.title: Cross-check model
crossCheckModel.description: The model the cross-check agent runs on, as an alias (opus, sonnet) or a model id.
